Python.tip: Learn variables, functions, lists and dictionaries, then build a small script that reads a file.

Java.tip: Learn classes, objects and collections, then build a small console app such as a library system.

JavaScript.tip: Learn variables, functions and the DOM, then make a small interactive web page.

TypeScript.tip: Learn how types work in JavaScript, then convert a small JavaScript project to TypeScript.

C.tip: Practise pointers, arrays and memory handling by writing small programs.

C++.tip: Learn classes, the STL containers and file handling, then build a small project like a billing system.

C#.tip: Learn classes and LINQ, then build a small console or desktop app.

Embedded C.tip: Practise bit operations, pointers and reading and writing hardware registers on a small microcontroller board.

Bash.tip: Learn basic commands, pipes and loops, then automate a small task such as renaming files.

Kotlin.tip: Learn the basics of the language, then build a small Android app.

HTML.tip: Build a simple page with headings, lists, links, forms and images.

CSS.tip: Practise layouts with Flexbox and Grid, and make a page that works on phones.

React.tip: Learn components, props and state, then build a small to-do or weather app.

Redux.tip: Learn why shared state is needed in React apps, then add Redux to a small project.

Node.js.tip: Learn how to run JavaScript on a server and build a small API with it.

Express.tip: Build a small REST API with routes to create, read, update and delete items.

Next.js.tip: Learn routing and server-side rendering by building a small multi-page site.

Angular.tip: Learn components and services, then build a small data-driven page.

Vue.js.tip: Learn components and reactive data, then build a small interactive page.

Tailwind CSS.tip: Style a page using utility classes instead of writing custom CSS.

Bootstrap.tip: Build a responsive page using the grid system and ready-made components.

Webpack.tip: Learn how bundling works by setting up a small project that bundles JavaScript and CSS.

Vite.tip: Create a small project with Vite and see how quick development builds are.

Django.tip: Follow the official tutorial to build a small site with models, views and an admin page.

Flask.tip: Build a small web app with a few routes and a database.

FastAPI.tip: Build a small API and explore the automatic documentation page it creates.

Spring Boot.tip: Build a small REST API with Spring Boot connected to a database.

Spring MVC.tip: Learn controllers, views and request handling by building a small web app.

Spring Security.tip: Add login and role-based access to a small Spring Boot app.

Hibernate.tip: Learn how Java objects map to database tables by building a small project.

JPA.tip: Learn entities and repositories by storing and querying data in a small Spring Boot app.

REST API.tip: Learn HTTP methods and status codes, then build and test an API with Postman.

Microservices.tip: Learn how an app can be split into small services that talk to each other, and build two small ones.

JWT.tip: Learn how token-based login works and add it to a small API.

Kafka.tip: Learn topics, producers and consumers by sending messages between two small programs.

Swagger.tip: Add Swagger or OpenAPI documentation to a small API.

SQL.tip: Practise SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY and subqueries on a sample database.

MySQL.tip: Install MySQL, create tables and practise queries and joins.

PostgreSQL.tip: Install PostgreSQL and practise queries, joins and indexes on a sample database.

MongoDB.tip: Learn documents and collections, then store and query data from a small app.

SQLite.tip: Use SQLite from Python to store data for a small project without installing a server.

Redis.tip: Learn how to cache values with Redis and set expiry times.

Pandas.tip: Practise loading a CSV file, cleaning it and summarising it with groupby.

NumPy.tip: Learn arrays and vectorised operations, then redo a loop-based task with NumPy.

Matplotlib.tip: Make line, bar and scatter charts from a small dataset.

Scikit-learn.tip: Train a simple classifier and measure its accuracy on a standard dataset.

TensorFlow.tip: Build and train a small neural network on a standard image dataset.

Keras.tip: Build a small neural network with Keras layers and train it on a simple dataset.

PyTorch.tip: Learn tensors and training loops, then train a small neural network.

OpenCV.tip: Learn to read images, convert them and detect faces or edges.

NLP.tip: Learn text cleaning and TF-IDF, then build a simple text classifier.

Machine Learning.tip: Learn the basics of supervised learning, then finish a small prediction project.

Deep Learning.tip: Learn how neural networks are trained, then build a small image classifier.

Computer Vision.tip: Build a small project that detects or classifies objects in images.

Hugging Face.tip: Use a pretrained model from the Hugging Face hub for a simple text task.

Statistics.tip: Revise mean, variance, distributions, hypothesis testing and correlation.

Feature Engineering.tip: Practise creating and choosing useful input columns for a prediction model.

Data Cleaning.tip: Practise handling missing values, duplicates and wrong formats in a messy dataset.

Data Visualization.tip: Turn a dataset into clear charts and explain what each one shows.

ETL.tip: Build a small pipeline that reads data, cleans it and loads it into a database.

A/B Testing.tip: Learn how to compare two versions of something using a significance test.

Power BI.tip: Build a dashboard from a sample dataset with slicers and a few charts.

Tableau.tip: Build an interactive dashboard from a sample dataset.

Excel.tip: Practise pivot tables, lookups and charts on a sample sheet.

Google Sheets.tip: Practise formulas, pivot tables and charts in Google Sheets.

MLflow.tip: Track the settings and results of a few training runs with MLflow.

Jupyter.tip: Do a small data analysis in a Jupyter notebook with notes and charts.

AWS.tip: Create a free account and practise launching a server (EC2) and storing files (S3).

Azure.tip: Create a free account and deploy a small web app on Azure.

GCP.tip: Create a free account and deploy a small app on Google Cloud.

Docker.tip: Package a small app into a container image and run it.

Kubernetes.tip: Run a small app on a local cluster such as minikube and learn pods and services.

Helm.tip: Install an app on Kubernetes using a Helm chart, then write a simple chart of your own.

Terraform.tip: Write a Terraform file that creates a cloud resource, then destroy it.

Ansible.tip: Write a playbook that installs and configures software on a test machine.

Infrastructure as Code.tip: Learn to define servers and networks in code, using a tool such as Terraform.

Jenkins.tip: Set up a Jenkins pipeline that builds and tests a small project.

GitHub Actions.tip: Add a workflow that runs tests on every push to a small repository.

GitLab CI.tip: Add a pipeline file that builds and tests a small project on GitLab.

CI/CD.tip: Learn how code is built, tested and deployed automatically, and set up a simple pipeline.

Linux.tip: Practise common commands, file permissions and managing processes in a terminal.

Nginx.tip: Install Nginx and use it to serve a site and forward requests to an app.

Prometheus.tip: Collect metrics from a small app and view them in Prometheus.

Grafana.tip: Build a dashboard from Prometheus metrics.

ELK.tip: Send logs from a small app into Elasticsearch and view them in Kibana.

Git.tip: Practise commits, branches, merges and resolving conflicts.

GitHub.tip: Practise pull requests, issues and reviewing changes on a small repository.

Maven.tip: Learn how to build a Java project and manage its dependencies with Maven.

JUnit.tip: Write unit tests for a small Java class using JUnit.

Mockito.tip: Learn to replace dependencies with mocks when testing a Java class.

Pytest.tip: Write tests for a small Python module with pytest.

Jest.tip: Write tests for a small JavaScript function or React component with Jest.

Unit Testing.tip: Learn to write small automated tests for single functions and run them regularly.

Selenium.tip: Automate a login flow in a browser with a Selenium script.

Postman.tip: Send requests to an API and write a few checks in Postman.

ARM Cortex-M.tip: Learn the architecture basics and write a small program for a Cortex-M board.

STM32.tip: Get an STM32 board, blink an LED, then read a sensor.

ESP32.tip: Get an ESP32 board and send sensor data over Wi-Fi.

FreeRTOS.tip: Create two tasks that share data through a queue on a development board.

RTOS.tip: Learn tasks, scheduling, queues and semaphores, and how they differ from a simple main loop.

UART.tip: Send and receive text between a board and your computer over a serial connection.

SPI.tip: Read data from an SPI sensor or memory chip with a development board.

I2C.tip: Read data from an I2C sensor with a development board.

CAN Bus.tip: Learn how CAN frames work and send messages between two boards or in a simulator.

MQTT.tip: Publish sensor readings to an MQTT broker and subscribe from another program.

GDB.tip: Learn to set breakpoints, step through code and inspect variables with GDB.

JTAG.tip: Learn how a debug probe connects to a board and use it to flash and debug code.

Oscilloscope.tip: Learn to measure signals such as clock and data lines with an oscilloscope.

Logic Analyzer.tip: Capture and decode a serial signal such as UART or I2C.

MISRA C.tip: Read the main MISRA C rules and run a static analysis tool on your own code.

Embedded Linux.tip: Run Linux on a board such as a Raspberry Pi and learn to build and run programs on it.

Device Drivers.tip: Write a simple Linux kernel module or a basic peripheral driver.

CMake.tip: Set up a small C++ project with a CMakeLists file and build it.

Makefile.tip: Write a Makefile that compiles a small C program.

Figma.tip: Recreate a screen of a real app in Figma using frames and components.

Adobe XD.tip: Adobe has stopped adding new features to XD, so practise the same prototyping skills in Figma first.

Sketch.tip: Design a screen using symbols and shared styles in Sketch.

Photoshop.tip: Practise editing images and layers, and exporting assets for the web.

Illustrator.tip: Practise drawing icons and logos with vector shapes.

Miro.tip: Use Miro to make a user flow or a brainstorming board.

Wireframing.tip: Sketch low-detail layouts for an app before choosing colours and fonts.

Prototyping.tip: Turn a few screens into a clickable prototype and test it with friends.

User Research.tip: Interview a few users about a problem and summarise what you learned.

Usability Testing.tip: Watch someone use your prototype and note where they get stuck.

User Flows.tip: Draw the steps a user takes to complete one task in an app.

Personas.tip: Create a persona from your research, with goals and frustrations.

Information Architecture.tip: Organise an app's content into clear sections and menus, and test it with card sorting.

Interaction Design.tip: Learn how buttons, animations and feedback guide users through a screen.

Responsive Design.tip: Design a page for phone, tablet and desktop widths.

Design Systems.tip: Build a small set of reusable colours, text styles and components.

UI/UX.tip: Learn the difference between how a product looks and how it works, then redesign one app screen.

Accessibility.tip: Learn the basics of WCAG, such as colour contrast and keyboard use, and check one of your designs.

Design Thinking.tip: Learn the five stages (empathise, define, ideate, prototype, test) and apply them to a small problem.

SEO.tip: Learn keyword research and on-page basics, then optimise a small blog or site.

SEM.tip: Learn how paid search works and run a small campaign with a tiny budget.

Google Ads.tip: Practise building a search campaign with ad groups and keywords.

Facebook Ads.tip: Practise setting up a small ad campaign with audience targeting.

Content Marketing.tip: Plan a month of content for one audience and write a few posts.

Social Media Marketing.tip: Plan and schedule posts for a small account and track which ones perform best.

Email Marketing.tip: Write a short email campaign and learn about open and click rates.

Mailchimp.tip: Build an email list and send a test campaign in Mailchimp.

Copywriting.tip: Practise writing headlines and short ads, and compare which version works better.

Keyword Research.tip: Find what people search for in a topic using a free keyword tool.

Canva.tip: Design a few social media posts with Canva templates.

WordPress.tip: Set up a small WordPress site with a theme and a few pages.

HubSpot.tip: Take HubSpot's free marketing courses and try its free CRM.

Google Analytics.tip: Add Google Analytics to a small site and learn to read the basic reports.

Agile.tip: Learn sprints, stand-ups and user stories, and use a simple board to plan a small project.

Scrum.tip: Learn the Scrum roles, events and artifacts, and run a small sprint with friends.

OOP.tip: Learn classes, inheritance and polymorphism, and build a small project with them.

Data Structures.tip: Practise arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees and hash maps.

Algorithms.tip: Practise sorting, searching and recursion, and solve problems on a coding site.

Communication Skills.tip: Practise explaining your projects clearly in two minutes, out loud.

Problem Solving.tip: Practise breaking problems into steps and solving a few coding problems each week.

File Handling.tip: Practise reading and writing text and CSV files in your main language.

Code Review.tip: Practise giving and receiving feedback on pull requests.

Debugging.tip: Practise using a debugger with breakpoints, and reading error messages and logs.
